summary: Make long-run heartbeats append-only Telegram evidence
description: Replace edit-in-place long-running heartbeats with durable separate messages. Heartbeats and milestones must bypass cleanup, preserve thread metadata, remain best-effort, and keep tool chatter suppressed. Configure the default Telegram cadence to 30 minutes without interrupting active runs.
acceptance: Every long-running heartbeat is delivered as a new permanent message with a real platform timestamp; no heartbeat is edited or cleanup-eligible; milestones remain permanent; failure remains fail-open and thread metadata is preserved.
verification: python -m pytest tests/gateway/test_progress_milestone_delivery.py tests/gateway/test_display_config.py -o 'addopts=' -q; python -m pytest tests/gateway -k 'long_running or milestone or heartbeat' -o 'addopts=' -q; python -m py_compile gateway/run.py gateway/display_config.py; git diff --check; bash scripts/validate-go.sh
